verdict.rationale: Spline documents an official, first-party Spline MCP Server on a dedicated docs page. It connects MCP clients such as Claude, Cursor, Codex, VS Code, Antigravity and ChatGPT directly to the open editor, and the desktop app bundles it and registers itself with those clients automatically. It ships only in the desktop app, not in the browser. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that agent connections work as described, documentation of the exposed tool surface, and browser (non-desktop) availability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: The **Spline MCP Server** connects AI coding tools like **Claude**, **Cursor**, **Codex**, and **Antigravity** directly to your Spline editor.
Spline MCP Server — drive Spline from Claude, Cursor, Codex and other MCP clients, straight into your open editor tab.
The MCP server is bundled in the desktop app, so connecting Claude, Cursor, VS Code, Antigravity or ChatGPT to your editor only works here — there's nothing to install or configure
